name: catalyst_comprehensive_directional_center_v1
objective: Build a genuinely broader bidirectional Catalyst model by combining the already validated direction-specific protein representations with the already validated bounded reaction-center representation, while retaining an exact clean matched reconstruction of the current R2E mainline as the safety baseline.

development.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

model_family.base: random-init bidirectional hard-reservoir dual tower on the frozen split
model_family.cap_policy: single inherited cap=0.10 from the already confirmed V3 geometry; no cap sweep on this development split

center_training_recipe.r2e_candidate_scope: all training proteins, matching the historical bounded-center residual objective
center_training_recipe.e2r_candidate_scope: all positives for the sampled protein queries plus globally highest frozen-base teacher-scoring train reactions and random train reactions; teacher scores and clean train associations only
center_training_recipe.reason_for_e2r_sampling: reaction embeddings depend on the trainable residual, so exact all-reaction recomputation at every optimizer step is unnecessarily expensive; the frozen teacher selects a fixed-capacity train-only hard pool without target benchmark information

comparisons.r2e_safety_baseline: fresh matched ESM-C + RDKit+ + center cap=0.10 model using the current-mainline architecture on the new split
comparisons.e2r_candidate: ESM-C + EnzGFM equal-block + RDKit+ + center cap=0.10

r2e_full_candidate_required: pooled MRR candidate >= matched current-mainline safety baseline
r2e_low_reaction_similarity_required: reaction_similarity<0.3 median best-positive rank candidate <= baseline
e2r_full_candidate_required: pooled MRR candidate >= equal-block RDKit+ baseline
development_gate.fold_stability: For each direction, MRR and MAP may not regress by more than 0.005 on any development fold and must improve on at least 2/3 folds for at least one of the two metrics.
development_gate.material_gain: At least one direction must achieve either +0.01 absolute MRR, +0.01 absolute MAP, or +2.0 percentage points Hit@10 on pooled full-candidate development support; otherwise keep the current routed system even if floors pass.
development_gate.if_fail: Reject this integration family on this split. Do not tune cap, salt, fold, router threshold, or external benchmark against the revealed development results.
development_gate.if_pass: Freeze exact model recipes and run the already frozen confirmation split once.

post_confirmation.production_integration: Only after confirmation passes; package direction-specific models into the benchmark-agnostic routed system and then re-run open-world confidence/production-retention checks without selecting on their revealed labels.

base_direction_weights.rationale: R2E uses the already confirmed current-mainline R2E-heavy recipe for a matched safety comparison; E2R preserves the previously clean-selected balanced equal-block base recipe. This correction is frozen before any new split performance is materialized.
